about: Kincardine is a municipality on Lake Huron in Bruce County, Ontario, covering the former town and surrounding countryside—not only a downtown strip. A historic harbour with a iconic lighthouse, Scottish heritage, and the nearby Bruce nuclear complex shape a lakeside community. About 12,000 people live in Kincardine.
